about_us_description:
For over 15 years, EMS Electrical Marine Services has been offering specialized solutions in the field of marine electrical services for both leisure and commercial vessels. Based in Corfu, we specialize in electrical installations, system refurbishments, and certifications according to Greek and international regulations.

Our experienced team offers:

• New electrical installations tailored to each vessel
• Complete electrical system refurbishments for any type of vessel
• On-site or in-shop electrical equipment repairs
• A wide variety of ready-to-use spare parts from leading domestic and international suppliers

We provide immediate support across Greece and also serve Albania by arrangement. Our mobile team can reach your vessel within 2 hours anywhere in the Ionian.

At EMS, we continuously monitor developments and new products in the field, ensuring that we offer modern, functional, and high-quality solutions. Our mission is to combine technical excellence, reliability, and personalized support—keeping your vessel safe, functional, and ready for the next trip.

slogan_paragraph:
Electrical Marine Services (EMS), based in Corfu, has been a trusted force in marine electrics for over 15 years. We deliver high-performance electrical installations, precision upgrades, and on-demand emergency support for yachts and pleasure boats across Greece and Albania.

Whether you're docked in port or adrift at sea, EMS brings expert service to your vessel — anywhere in the Ionian, within 2 hours. Count on us to keep your journey safe, smooth, and powered with absolute confidence.
